procedure.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
procedure.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1-v2 as V = Qe * tau, from a CO2 rise at reduced speed then a decay at full speed, occupants as the source.

steps.why: Rise: reduce effective flow to 0.3 m3/min (floor speed) so CO2 climbs from 2000 ppm towards a higher equilibrium; hatch closed and held closed.
Decay: full speed (Qe = 1 m3/min), record the fall towards equilibrium; about one time constant (first guess V=30 m3, tau=30 min). Hatch unchanged.

monitoring.reason: The two lab occupants breathe the air whose CO2 is raised by the test; hab-b occupants are not exposed with the hatch closed.

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
a monitored person out of band, monitoring lost, or one more person in the lab

expected.rise: Starting at about 2000 ppm with 2 occupants (0.76 L/min CO2 at 0.38 L/min each), 30% speed: CO2 rises slowly towards about 2500 ppm (G/Qe with Qe=0.3 m3/min), i.e. roughly +100 to +200 ppm over 25 min, peak well under 3000 ppm; a rise under sensor noise or a drop means exchange through the hatch or a wrong source.
expected.decay: At full speed CO2 falls towards C_eq about 760 ppm above the scrubber-free baseline (G/Qe, Qe=1 m3/min) with tau = V/Qe; first guess V=30 m3 gives tau about 30 min (plus 3.33 min lag). Fit C(t)=C_eq+(C0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau); V_lab = Qe*tau, expected 10 to 200 m3 (default 30).
expected.refutation: A fitted C_eq far from G/Qe, non-exponential residuals, or hab-b CO2 moving in step with the lab would show the lab is not one closed well-mixed zone (hatch exchange, design 3 m3/min hatch-closed ventilation) and V would be an overestimate of the served volume.

hypotheses: Lab air is one well-mixed zone.

Exchange through the closed hatch to hab-b is not measured; it is a hypothesis (station-topology gives a design inter-module ventilation of 3 m3/min hatch closed), not assumed zero; hab-b CO2 is recorded to reveal it.
Occupants' number and activity (awake, 0.38 L/min each) are constant during the test; no one enters or leaves.
Effective flow at full speed Qe = 1 m3/min per datasheet and scales linearly with speed; lag 3.33 min is ignored in the fit after the first ~10 min of each step.
Sensor co2-1-v2 is accurate and its noise is small against the expected swing.

justifications.reason: Below the 3200 ppm ceiling; start 2000 ppm leaves over 200 ppm headroom; expected peak about 2200.
At the signed ceiling, below ELEVATED 3500 ppm.
Same abort ceiling, at or below 3200 ppm.
Reduced speed at the floor gives the largest rise allowed.
Full speed, above the 30 percent floor, for the decay.
At the signed 60 min ceiling; steps total 55 min.
Above the 35 percent minimum for margin.
Signed lower heart-rate bound; matches monitor default band.
Signed upper heart-rate bound; matches monitor default band.

justifications.reference: rise tau = V/Qe(30%) = 30/0.3 = 100 min, too long for the 60 min cap; 25 min chosen so both steps fit within 60 (25+30=55)
justifications.reason: Budget split under the duration cap; rise limited by the speed floor.

justifications.reference: tau = V/Qe = 30 m3 / 1 m3/min = 30 min (first guess V=30 m3, library default)
justifications.reason: One time constant of decay at full speed.
